newsitem.title: USA: BPA plans to bring Intertie to 6,250 MW late Thurs.
newsitem.headline: BPA plans to bring Intertie to 6,250 MW late Thurs.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration now expects to bring the Pacific Intertie transmission lines up to 6,250 megawatts (MW) late Thursday, a spokseman for the agency said.
BPA previously said the increase would go into effect this weekend, but repairs to a key 500 kilovolt Oregon line segment are now expected to be finished later Thursday, he said.
The increase from the current rate of 5,200 MW was approved last Friday by the Western Systems Coordinating Council.
